parsed.faithful: In America they have no affes at all, nor yet horfes; but they have been carried thither long ago, at first by the Spaniards, and afterwards by other nations, where they have multiplied greatly; in fome places, there are whole droves of them that run wild, and are very hard to be caught. Afes in general carry the heaviest burdens in proportion to their bulk; and, as their keeping costs little or nothing, it is a great wonder they are not put to more uses than they generally are among us.
parsed.modern: In America they have no asses at all, nor yet horses; but they have been carried thither long ago, at first by the Spaniards, and afterwards by other nations, where they have multiplied greatly; in some places, there are whole droves of them that run wild, and are very hard to be caught. Asses in general carry the heaviest burdens in proportion to their bulk; and, as their keeping costs little or nothing, it is a great wonder they are not put to more uses than they generally are among us.
